text: Led the firm's Databricks practice as internal Data Engineering Lead, owning technical standards, internal enablement, and POC architecture.
Cut migration delivery time by building an LLM-assisted framework that automated schema translation and pipeline conversion from Snowflake, Teradata, and SQL Server to a modern lakehouse.

Led data architecture for a top-5 QSR supply chain engagement: designed a medallion architecture on AWS, implemented dbt as the orchestration and semantic layer, and established data governance from a greenfield start.
Lead Architect for a Fortune 500 financial-sector client: defined the implementation strategy for integrating a newly acquired entity's data, ensuring historical and new data integrated efficiently.
Built a reusable Infrastructure-as-Code accelerator (Terraform and Bicep) that deploys end-to-end lakehouse platforms on AWS and Azure with governance and DataOps pipelines built in.
Delivered an on-prem to AWS cloud migration for a top client in 6 months, managing the onshore/offshore delivery team.
Ran internal technical workshops and supported pre-sales solutioning with architecture artifacts, demos, and SOW scope validation.
